name: MEA Local — Extracted Payment Service (Quarkus)
_comment: FORWARD-REFERENCE (payment-plan.md S4+, not yet exercised by S2): points the SAME behavior-equivalence suite at the extracted Quarkus Payment service (examples/05-payment-service/) once it exists, on its own port so it can run side-by-side with the monolith during the strangler cutover. Nothing in the current collection targets this baseUrl directly yet — a future 'Payment Context Contract' folder for /api/payments is deferred to payment-plan.md S4/S5 (scope discipline: S2 only adapts the existing checkout folders for the async contract, DRQ-055). What IS already exercised against this service indirectly, once payment-plan S6+ wires the choreography, is Scenario 1's and Scenario 3's bounded-wait polls of GET /api/orders/{id} run through the monolith/proxy baseUrl — this environment only becomes directly relevant once a payment read-surface folder is added. The collection itself must NOT change to target this file (that is the equivalence gate, DRQ-014); update `baseUrl` here (and/or point it at the Camel strangler proxy's payment route) once S7/S8 stand the cutover up.
